selections.rationale: Clear current-platform architecture signal with governed orchestration and policy controls; avoids the less accessible L0 terminology.
Stronger causal structure connecting executive-aligned adoption, workflow value, commercialization, and forecasting without excessive keyword density.
Directly frames production reliability as the outcome and supports it with distinct observability, evaluation, telemetry, and rollback mechanisms.
Preserves the strongest quantified lifecycle improvement and clearly identifies the platform standards and governance mechanisms behind it.
Provides concrete cloud and data-platform context while maintaining a focused high-availability architecture claim.
Combines a protected team-growth metric with platform commercialization, productization, and disciplined operating-model leadership.
